title: Server Admin Flow
summary: A server-focused starter with PlayerCore, RuntimeGuard, DataCore, HoloMap, MissionCore, Index, and TutorialCore.
body: A multiplayer-safe ECHO starter focused on permissions, homes, team markers, diagnostics, server budgets, backups, and optional shared systems.
steps: Configure PlayerCore before opening the server.
Use RuntimeGuard categories for low-end profiles.
Keep optional integrations documented for players.
